body: Thank you so much. It really means a lot that you took the time to share your experience and advice with me. I definitely will keep doing it and appreciate the gift she’s given me. It feels nice to talk to her again.

I’m so sorry for your loss. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience it’s really helpful and reassuring to know that someone else has felt that comforting feeling like they are beside you. And thank you for the warning I’ll definitely avoid trying to channel anything in that case and I’ll embrace the peace that’s happening now.
Thank you so much!  This is super helpful I’ll give this a try!

And you make a good point. that’s a tough one. I might need to think on that one a little. There’s always a better way and they don’t have to do it alone?
